source_fact: GiftbagUseWindow submits item_id,gift_id,num to MID241 and removes num source items after OK; GiftTable preserves ordered drops; DropboxTable exposes candidate item_id/item_num while drop_rate/roll_type remain server-side table facts.
compatibility_decision: Positive drop_rate values are denominator-free relative integer weights; zero cannot win; ordered/repeated drop occurrences execute once each per gift copy; num repeats operation then aggregates.
